units.source_text: 永恒的、绝对的金阁出现了。

en.t: The eternal, absolute Golden Pavilion appeared.

units.source_text: 毋庸赘言，我的眼睛变成金阁的眼睛时，恐怕世界就将这样变形，

en.t: Needless to say, when my eyes became the eyes of the Golden Pavilion, the world would probably be transformed in this way,

units.source_text: 而且在这变形的世界里，谁有金阁保持原来的形态，占有美，

en.t: and in this transformed world, only the Golden Pavilion would keep its original form and possess beauty,

units.source_text: 其余的东西都将完全化为灰尘。

en.t: while everything else would be completely reduced to dust.

units.source_text: 自从那娼妇踏足金阁的庭院以来，还有自从鹤川摔死以来，

en.t: Ever since that prostitute set foot in the garden of the Golden Pavilion, and ever since Tsurukawa fell to his death,

units.source_text: 我心中反复地提出这样的问题：

en.t: this question had come up again and again in my heart:

units.source_text: 尽管如此，行恶是可能的吗？

en.t: Even so, is it possible to do evil?
